_sanity.label: thr sweep >
_sanity.why: a full-circle amide rotation rises to a saddle, falls to cis, rises to the other saddle and falls back: four monotonic runs. More means a point is out of place

_sanity.label: pthr1 scan vs free minimum
_sanity.why: the lowest point of a relaxed scan must agree with a free minimisation of the same molecule: if it does not, the scan is trapped in a strained arrangement. Forcing omega from its embedded value to 180 deg in one step wrenched Ac-Thr-Pro-NHMe by 175 deg and left the whole scan 41 kcal/mol above the true minimum
